# `x4stats`

```text
usage: x4stats [-h] [--version] {wares,macro} ...

Advisory numeric comparison of mod content vs the effective game.

positional arguments:
  {wares,macro}
    wares        compare a candidate mod's wares to same-group peers
    macro        flatten a macro file's numeric property vector

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --version      show program's version number and exit
```

## `x4stats wares`

```text
usage: x4stats wares [-h] [--ext-dir EXT_DIR] [--reference REFERENCE] candidate

positional arguments:
  candidate             candidate mod folder

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ext-dir EXT_DIR     extensions dir (default: game-root from _registry)
  --reference REFERENCE
                        unpacked base+DLC tree ($X4_REFERENCE)
```
